description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAttachmentDecorator' provides a decorator for the EmployeeAttachment entity in the OrangeHRM project. It adds methods for formatting attachment dates, retrieving attachment content as a string, and associating employees by their employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeAttachment entity providing additional methods for date formatting, attachment content retrieval, and employee association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the decorator with an EmployeeAttachment entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the encapsulated EmployeeAttachment entity.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date when the attachment was added.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted time when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the attachment using an employee number.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment content as a string, using stream_get_contents.
